D.t: Val Hoyle leads by 16.6 in the forecast and wins 99% of simulations. The cushion is about 56,947 votes; a one point swing is about 1,716 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +8.4 and D +25.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$521K cash against $388K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.

R.t: Monique DeSpain trails by 16.6 and wins 1% of simulations. Closing it takes about 28,474 voters switching sides, or 56,947 more net votes from new turnout.
